 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    freq = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg)
    marker = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    template = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != marker]
    if not template:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, r1 = min(x[0] for x in template), max(x[0] for x in template)
    c0, c1 = min(x[1] for x in template), max(x[1] for x in template)
    ar, ac = (r0 + r1) // 2, (c0 + c1) // 2
    # Include background-colored cells inside the template's bounding box when
    # the template has a non-background, non-marker color at that coordinate only
    # if they are explicitly encoded (not inferable); thus copy the visible cells.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in points:
        for tr, tc, val in template:
            rr, cc = r + tr - ar, c + tc - ac
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = val
        out[r][c] = grid[ar][ac]
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo = [[0]*29 for _ in range(14)]
    demo[10][0], demo[11][0], demo[12][0] = 8,1,1
    for r,c in [(1,4),(2,19),(2,24),(2,26),(3,22),(3,28),(4,1),(6,13),(6,16),(6,24),(6,27),(7,0),(7,6),(7,10),(7,19),(10,9),(10,17),(10,22),(10,24),(11,4),(11,14),(11,20),(12,2),(12,11)]:
        demo[r][c]=3
    result=transform(demo)
    expected=[[0]*29 for _ in range(14)]
    for r,c in [(1,4),(2,19),(2,24),(2,26),(3,22),(3,28),(4,1),(6,13),(6,16),(6,24),(6,27),(7,0),(7,6),(7,10),(7,19),(10,9),(10,17),(10,22),(10,24),(11,4),(11,14),(11,20),(12,2),(12,11)]:
        expected[r-1][c]=8; expected[r][c]=1; expected[r+1][c]=1
    expected[10][0],expected[11][0],expected[12][0]=8,1,1
    print('demo_match', result == expected)
    test = [[4]*13 for _ in range(20)]
    test[11][7:9]=[5,5]; test[12][6:9]=[8,5,8]; test[13][6:9]=[8,5,0]
    for r,c in [(1,2),(1,9),(6,11),(7,4),(13,11),(12,2),(17,4),(17,8)]: test[r][c]=1
    ans=transform(test)
    print('test_dimensions',len(ans),len(ans[0]))
    print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in ans))
    ",
 "cross_profile": false
}
